publication_scope: Sanitized narrative summaries from development-log research; no private raw artifacts or private repository links. These notes are not accepted benchmark evidence.
configuration_status: Host, workers and full timing protocol for intermediate milestones await confirmation; numeric development measurements are omitted.

milestones.title: Dense group IDs
milestones.lesson: Use compact group identities to avoid repeated grouping work.

milestones.title: COUNT DISTINCT radix
milestones.lesson: A more suitable distinct-counting strategy reduced repeated work in a slow query.

milestones.title: Reuse filtered scans
milestones.lesson: Avoid scanning and filtering the same input repeatedly.

milestones.title: Use actual row counts
milestones.lesson: Optimization admission must reflect actual cardinality. Keep corrected measurements instead of choosing the first, more favorable timing.

milestones.title: Dynamic scan claiming
milestones.lesson: Improve how workers claim scan work; worker count alone does not guarantee useful parallelism.

milestones.title: Pipeline continuations
milestones.lesson: Scheduling changes need resource ownership and cancellation checks as well as timing. A matching committed tree does not itself prove a binary rebuild comparison.

milestones.title: Combined development attempt
milestones.lesson: Total time and geometric mean can disagree. A provisional near-parity total from one attempt is not an accepted release result.
